pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surahs? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Surahs has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Surahs with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Selected Surahs to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surahs.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Attributes of Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Attributes of Allah.
   B. Apply the teaching of Attributes of Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Attributes of Allah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Attributes of Allah has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on Etiquette of Eating to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on Etiquette of Eating has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Etiquette of Eating.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on brushing teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on brushing teeth.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on brushing teeth with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Hadith on brushing teeth has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith on brushing teeth to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

6. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

7. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Angels Atid,? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in Angels Atid, to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Angels Atid,.
   C. Say Belief in Angels Atid, has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in Angels Atid, with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Conditions for Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Conditions for Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Conditions for Swalah.
   C. Say Conditions for Swalah has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Conditions for Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

10. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Fitness? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on Fitness has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Fitness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Fitness.
   D. Use Hadith on Fitness to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Swalah.
   B. Use Pillars of Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Pillars of Swalah has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara Types of Najasaat? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Twahara Types of Najasaat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Twahara Types of Najasaat to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Twahara Types of Najasaat has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara Types of Najasaat.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Wudhu and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Conditions for Swalah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Pillars of Swalah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues: Kindness to Allah’s Creatures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Apply the teaching of Selected Surahs with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. B — Apply the teaching of Attributes of Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. B — Apply the teaching of Hadith on brushing teeth with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

6. A — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

7. D — Apply the teaching of Belief in Angels Atid, with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. D — Apply the teaching of Conditions for Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. C — Telling the truth and keeping trust

10. B — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Fitness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. C — Apply the teaching of Pillars of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Apply the teaching of Twahara Types of Najasaat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Wudhu; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Conditions for Swalah; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Pillars of Swalah; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Virtues: Kindness to Allah’s Creatures; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
